sample.selection: Latest up to 1000 card-method transactions per type and year, sorted by internal ID descending. Methods 4,5,6,8,11. This is a stratified historical sample, not a full-account audit.

findings: Many older card payments/refunds have no recorded last-four digits; a transaction reference alone is insufficient to recover them.
Verified payment method IDs: Cash 1, Check 2, Master Card 4, VISA 5, American Express 6, EFT 7, Debit Card 8, EMT 9, Direct Deposit 10, UnionPay 11, Wechat/Alipay 13.
Invoice-to-payment NextTransactionLineLink Payment rows carry applied amounts. Credit applications are separate CustCred rows and must not manufacture new cash/card funding.
Customer Refund apply sublists identify the actual credit memo/payment and amount applied; the tested invoice-to-payment link query did not expose refund links.
Credit memo transaction lines include COGS mirror lines. Item sublist / iscogs=F avoids counting these as extra pallets.
Observed six-pallet credit subtotal 240, tax 31.20, total 271.20; user confirmed cash excludes tax and all other methods include tax.
Some pallet credits were applied against later invoices instead of refunded; those require explicit reviewed settlement allocations.
Exact customer-history query succeeded for customer 5240: 209 records, including 59 pallet invoices, 26 pallet credits, 102 payments and 22 refunds at that read time.
note: Original permission-failure audit remains intact. This follow-up records newly granted access and the actual historical observations used to design the parser.
